MODULE_NOTES: One panel along the bottom of the screen: your portrait, the game menu, the experience bar, money and bags.
CMD_PORTRAIT: face or live: your portrait as a picture or as a live 3D head
PANEL_HEIGHT_TIP: The panel's height. Its buttons, icons and bar grow with it.
PANEL_CHARBUTTON_TIP: Your portrait with your level in the screen's corner, or a menu button with your face.
PANEL_MICROICONS_TIP: Blizzard's icons scaled to one size, or the same icons in one gold colour.
